title: What if Earth stopped spinning for one second?
caption:
Your coffee would break the sound barrier. ☕🌍

The ground at the equator moves east at about 465 m/s (40,075 km every 23.93 h, NASA). Sound in air: 343 m/s at 20 °C.

Stop Earth's spin for one second and the ground halts, but everything loose keeps going east at that speed.

Halfway to the pole (45°) it's still about 329 m/s, close to the speed of sound. At the North Pole: almost nothing.

Send this to the friend who never secures the coffee in the car.

Tomorrow: boiling an egg on Everest. 🔔 Follow @the.impossible.lab (or subscribe on YouTube) so you don't miss it.

⚠️ Don't try this. The same physics hits you in a car that brakes hard: loose objects (and unbelted people) keep moving. Buckle up and secure loose items.
